name: Slot Shite kara ne
source:
School slot club is on the brink of survival after getting in debt. School director organizes a competition between slot clubs of two schools. The winner gets both finances and ability to treat loses in any way desired.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
学校老虎机社团因负债而濒临解散。校长组织了两所学校老虎机社团之间的比赛。胜者将获得资金，以及以任何方式处置败者的权利。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
